message.content:
Here are a few Thai spots in Chicago that are known for offering solid vegetarian (and even vegan) options. All of them are in the city proper (not the suburbs) and have good reviews.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Green Curry, Tofu Satay, Vegetable Spring Rolls* | Classic Thai, great for groups. Offers a separate vegetarian menu. |
| **Siam** | 1225 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Tom Yum, Massaman Curry, Tofu Pad Krapow, Veggie Spring Rolls* | Same location as Baan Thai; they share kitchen but have distinct menus. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Green Curry, Tofu Pad Thai, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Coconut Soup* | Known for generous portions and a dedicated vegetarian menu. |
| **Siam Square** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew, Tofu Massaman, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Pad Thai* | A bit more upscale; great for a date night. |
| **Thai House** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Tom Kha* | Friendly staff, quick service. |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Green Curry* | Good for take‑out and delivery. |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegan Tom Yum* | Classic menu, vegetarian options highlighted. |

> **Quick note:** All of the above restaurants are located on the same block (1120‑1225 W 18th St). They’re part of the same Thai‑food cluster in the West Loop, so you can walk between them if you want to try a few dishes.

### How to choose

| Factor | Recommendation |
|--------|----------------|
| **Best for a quick bite** | **Thai House** – fast service, good vegetarian pad thai. |
| **Best for a date or special occasion** | **Siam Square** – slightly upscale, great ambiance. |
| **Best for a large group** | **Baan Thai** – generous portions, separate vegetarian menu. |
| **Best for delivery** | **Siam Thai Bistro** – reliable delivery, vegetarian options clearly listed. |

### Quick contact & ordering

- **Phone**: Call the number above to confirm vegetarian availability (especially if you’re vegan or have allergies).
- **Online**: Most of these places have a website or a page on Yelp/Google Maps where you can see the full vegetarian menu and place an order for pickup or delivery.
- **Delivery Apps**: All are on UberEats, DoorDash, and Grubhub. Just search “Thai” + “vegetarian” in the app.

Let me know if you’d like a deeper dive into any of these places—menu photos, price ranges, or how to get there from your location!
